description: Configuration and utility functions for Vitest testing environment, including system load detection, worker scheduling, and test setup.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps a number between a minimum and maximum value.

methods.name: parsePositiveInt
methods.description: Parses a string as a positive integer, returns null if invalid.

methods.name: isSystemThrottleDisabled
methods.description: Checks environment variables to determine if system throttling is disabled.

methods.name: detectVitestHostInfo
methods.description: Detects system info such as CPU count, load average, and total memory.

methods.name: resolveLocalVitestMaxWorkers
methods.description: Calculates maximum number of workers based on environment and system info.

methods.name: resolveLocalVitestScheduling
methods.description: Determines scheduling parameters like maxWorkers, fileParallelism, and throttling based on environment and system load.
